title: Beaches around Kochi and Vypin
description: A starting point for exploring the coast around Fort Kochi and Vypin island.
intro: The Kochi coast includes Fort Kochi and several beaches on Vypin island. They are distinct places, not a single continuous beach walk. Check current access, weather and sea conditions locally; this list does not assess swimming safety.

entries.name: Fort Kochi Beach
entries.description: Known for the Chinese fishing nets and its nearby walkway, this beach is in historic Fort Kochi. Kerala Tourism notes that a section of the beach is controlled by the Navy and not accessible to visitors.
entries.details: Fort Kochi · fishing nets and waterfront

entries.name: Cherai Beach
entries.description: On the northern side of Vypin island, Cherai has a beachside walkway and a children’s park according to Kerala Tourism. It is a longer trip from central Kochi than the Fort Kochi waterfront.

entries.name: Kuzhupilly Beach
entries.description: Kerala Tourism names Kuzhupilly among Vypin island’s beaches. Verify current facilities and access before going, especially if you are planning around transport connections or the weather.

entries.name: Puthuvype Beach
entries.description: Puthuvype is another Vypin beach listed by Kerala Tourism. Treat local conditions and entry arrangements as changeable; check them before setting off rather than relying on an old timetable.
